Conferences & daytime production

Dedicated path for meetings, conferences, trade shows and filming — grounded in the source daytime-meetings page.

Builder + bot

Inspiration, offsite.

Fisher Bay Observatory Gallery & Terrace and Kanbar Forum are offered daily for daytime business meetings, team building and seminars. Larger gallery spaces become available on closed Mondays and Tuesdays.

  • Central Gallery: 500 theatre-style or 300 guests at rounds.
  • All meeting packages include museum admission during open hours.
  • Earlier load-in or Sunday-night load-in may be available for evening events.
  • Filming: waterfront views, educational settings, exhibits, interviews, demos and keynote speakers.
